snippet.title: Pasta Master (2008). Game by Jacob Buczynski, aka Jinxtengu.
snippet.description:
Description below, unfold.
Description from the author of the game: Pasta Master is an arcade area shooter. The controls consist of the arrow keys and the mouse. The game can be played with just the mouse but it’s designed To utilise both mouse and keyboard. The game also contains a hidden sub-game. The game was voted 6th best shooter in a Californian indie game compo. released in 2008.
Download link for Pasta Master game, classic games and other games on Jinxtengu website: http://www.revengeofthesunfish.com/gamesarc.html
The link to the site itself is from Jinxtengu: http://www.revengeofthesunfish.com/index.html
